title: Python daemon error specs fail when KANBUS_NO_DAEMON is set globally
description:
As a Kanbus maintainer, I want daemon error-handling behave scenarios to keep working, so that Python CI stays green.

Setting `os.environ[KANBUS_NO_DAEMON]=1` in `before_scenario` makes in-process `request_status` / `request_shutdown` / `request_index_list` raise `daemon disabled` instead of `daemon error`.

## Definition of Done

- `features/index/daemon_error_handling.feature` scenarios for status, stop, and list error responses pass.
- CLI scenarios still receive `KANBUS_NO_DAEMON=1` via `environment_overrides`.
- Right-now regeneration still skips listing failures instead of crashing.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Fixed. before_scenario no longer writes KANBUS_NO_DAEMON into os.environ. CLI still uses environment_overrides. The status/stop/list error steps enable the daemon for the in-process request so they raise daemon error, matching the Rust steps.

right_now_summary: Daemon error scenarios now pass while CLI overrides and right-now regeneration behavior remain intact.
